info.title: iBubbl API
info.description:
The iBubbl REST API. Send iMessages, manage contacts, and subscribe to webhook events from your backend.

Authenticate every request with a Bearer API key (`ib_pk_<hex>`) — generate one from your dashboard's API Access settings. See the [Authentication](/authentication) guide.

post.description:
Send a message to one contact (`contact_id`, or `to` — an E.164 phone number; the contact is created on first use), into an existing group (`chat_guid`), or to a new group (`participant_phones`). Exactly one of the four is required.

The response returns immediately with `status: "pending"` or `"queued"`. Delivery progress arrives as [webhook events](/webhooks/events) (`message.sent`, `message.delivered`, `message.read`, `message.failed`), or poll `GET /v1/messages/{id}`.

**Idempotency is required.** Provide a unique `idempotency_key` per logical send (UUIDv4 recommended); a retry with the same key and payload replays the original response, while a reused key with a different payload returns `409 idempotency_conflict`. See the [Idempotency](/idempotency) guide.

A send to an opted-out contact returns `422 contact_opted_out`; see [Suppression](/concepts/suppression).

On a `5xx` (including a `502`/`503` from the network edge during a deploy), retry with the same `idempotency_key`.

404.description: `not_found` (no contact with that `contact_id`) or `group_not_found` (no group with that `chat_guid`).

409.description: Idempotency key reused with a different payload.

422.description: Request rejected; see `detail.error`. `validation_error` (bad request shape), `contact_opted_out`, `contact_blocked`, `no_eligible_line`, `unresponsive_contact`, `cold_cap_exhausted`, `followup_cap_exhausted`, `daily_cap_exhausted`, `group_outbound_blocked_suppression`, `insufficient_participants`, `reply_target_not_found`, `reply_target_unsent`, or `reply_target_partly_unsent`.

500.description: `no_owner_rep` (your account has no active owner rep to send as) or `internal_error`. Retry with the same `idempotency_key`.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

get.description:
List your messages, inbound and outbound, newest first. Use it to catch up after your webhook endpoint was down, or to read a conversation's history.

Results are paginated: `has_more` tells you whether there is another page, and you get it by passing the `id` of the last message as `starting_after`. Pages are stable while new messages arrive: nothing is skipped or repeated. See [Pagination](/concepts/pagination).

Filters combine with AND. A filter value that matches nothing (including another account's `contact_id` or `chat_guid`) returns an empty page. An unknown or repeated query parameter returns `422 validation_error`.

Messages stay listed after their contact is deleted or blocked.

Lists allow 120 requests a minute per account, across all your API keys and all lists. Over that, the answer is `429 rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: How many items to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: starting_after

schema.description: The `id` of the last item on the page you already have. Returns the items that come after it, in the same order. Leave it out for the first page. An `id` that isn't one of yours returns `422 invalid_cursor`.
schema.title: Starting After

parameters.description: The `id` of the last item on the page you already have. Returns the items that come after it, in the same order. Leave it out for the first page. An `id` that isn't one of yours returns `422 invalid_cursor`.

parameters.name: contact_id

schema.description: Only messages with this contact: the 1:1 conversation, plus group messages they sent or that were addressed to them as the group's primary contact. For one whole conversation, use `conversation_id`.
schema.title: Contact Id

parameters.description: Only messages with this contact: the 1:1 conversation, plus group messages they sent or that were addressed to them as the group's primary contact. For one whole conversation, use `conversation_id`.

parameters.name: conversation_id

schema.description: Only messages in this conversation (1:1 or group).
schema.title: Conversation Id

parameters.description: Only messages in this conversation (1:1 or group).

parameters.name: chat_guid

schema.description: Only messages in the iMessage group with this `chat_guid`. It changes when a participant is added; the group's `conversation_id` doesn't.
schema.title: Chat Guid

parameters.description: Only messages in the iMessage group with this `chat_guid`. It changes when a participant is added; the group's `conversation_id` doesn't.

parameters.name: created_after

schema.description: Only messages with `created_at` strictly after this time. ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. `2026-11-10T09:30:00Z`; in a query string, write `Z` or encode `+` as `%2B`.
schema.title: Created After

parameters.description: Only messages with `created_at` strictly after this time. ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. `2026-11-10T09:30:00Z`; in a query string, write `Z` or encode `+` as `%2B`.

parameters.name: created_before

schema.description: Only messages with `created_at` strictly before this time. Same format as `created_after`.
schema.title: Created Before

parameters.description: Only messages with `created_at` strictly before this time. Same format as `created_after`.

422.description: `validation_error` (a bad, unknown or repeated query parameter, or `limit` outside 1–100) or `invalid_cursor` (`starting_after` is not one of your messages).

429.description: `rate_limited`: more than 120 list requests in 60 seconds from your account (all keys and all lists count together). Wait `Retry-After` seconds, then send the same request again.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

get.description:
Fetch a single message by its ID. Useful for polling the current delivery state when you can't subscribe to webhooks.

Returns `404 not_found` for both missing messages and messages owned by a different customer — existence is not leaked across tenants.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

post.description:
Upsert a contact by E.164 phone number. Returns `201 Created` on a new contact, `200 OK` on an existing match. A number whose only match is a deleted contact creates a new contact.

Optional fields (`first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `city`, `state`, `timezone`) apply only when the existing record's value is null — values set previously by a rep or by a prior API call are preserved. This protects human-edited data from being clobbered by automation; to overwrite, use `PATCH /v1/contacts/{id}`.

`tags` only ever adds tags. Every value is checked before anything is saved.

If `timezone` is provided, it must be one of the 20 supported IANA timezones (US, Canada, and a few international zones such as `Europe/London`); anything else returns `422 invalid_timezone`.

v1 has no endpoint to list or delete contacts.

422.description: `validation_error` (bad request shape, `phone` not E.164, an unknown field), `invalid_timezone`, `invalid_email`, `invalid_tag` or `duplicate_tag`.

500.description: `internal_error`: a tag was deleted twice while it was being added. Retry.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

get.description: Fetch a single contact by ID. Returns `404 not_found` for both missing contacts and contacts owned by a different customer — existence is not leaked across tenants.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

patch.description:
Overwrite the fields you send. Fields you leave out are not touched; a field sent as `null` is cleared. Unlike the upsert, this replaces values a rep set.

`phone` can't be changed. Tags have their own endpoints.

422.description: `validation_error` (bad request shape or an unknown field, including `phone` and `tags`), `invalid_timezone` or `invalid_email`.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

post.summary: Add a tag to a contact
post.description: Add one tag. Idempotent: a tag the contact already has answers `200` unchanged. The name matches an existing tag trimmed and case-insensitively; a new name creates the tag. A newly added tag can start workflows with a "Tag added" trigger.

422.description: `validation_error` (bad request shape or an unknown field), `invalid_tag` or `duplicate_tag`.

500.description: `internal_error`: a tag was deleted twice while it was being added. Retry.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a contact
delete.description: Remove a tag by name (URL-encode it), matched trimmed and case-insensitively. Idempotent: a tag the contact doesn't have answers `200` unchanged. Removing a tag starts no workflow.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

post.description:
Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive events. The response includes the signing secret **once** — store it immediately; it cannot be retrieved again. Use the secret to verify incoming webhook signatures (see [Signature verification](/guides/webhook-signatures)).

If `event_types` is omitted, the subscription receives all event types. You can register multiple subscriptions per account (e.g., one for production, one for staging).

Delivery is at-least-once with exponential backoff. Customer endpoints should be idempotent based on the event `id`.

422.description: `invalid_url` (URL is not HTTPS) or `validation_error` (for example an unknown event type).

500.description: `internal_error`: the subscription could not be saved. Retry.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

get.description: Returns all currently active webhook subscriptions for the authenticated customer. Revoked subscriptions are omitted — query them by ID directly (`GET /v1/webhooks/{id}`) if you need their history.

schema.title: Response V1 List Webhooks V1 Webhooks Get

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

get.description: Fetch a single subscription by ID. Returns the subscription regardless of revoked status (so you can inspect history). `404 not_found` is returned for both missing subscriptions and those owned by a different customer.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

delete.description:
Soft-revoke a subscription. After revocation, no further events are delivered to its URL. The row is retained for audit purposes; you can still fetch it with `GET /v1/webhooks/{id}` and see its `revoked_at` timestamp.

Revoking an already-revoked subscription is a no-op that returns `{"status": "already_revoked"}`.

403.description: `forbidden`: your iBubbl account is suspended or cancelled.

post.summary: Receive an event from a connected app
post.description:
Receive a webhook from a connected third-party app (for example Recharge) and start any workflow whose **Webhook received** trigger matches it.

The URL you paste into the sending app carries its own credential, so this endpoint takes no `Authorization` header. Create a source in **Settings → Inbound events** to get the full URL; the token is shown once.

**Any app (secret URL)** sources need no signature: the URL is the credential, so keep it private. They accept JSON or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` bodies and at most 60 requests a minute. Beyond that the answer is `429` while a workflow is listening on the source; with none listening, the event is accepted and dropped.

**Signed** sources must sign every request. For Recharge, that is the `X-Recharge-Hmac-Sha256` header computed with your **API Client Secret** — which is not the same value as your API token. An unsigned or mis-signed request returns `403 invalid_signature`.

**Redeliveries are safe.** Providers resend events, and Recharge's dunning fires one event per charge retry. Each workflow's `event_id_path` identifies the underlying object, so repeat deliveries of the same event fold onto the run that already exists rather than messaging the customer again.

A `200` means the event was accepted, not that it matched anything — check `runs_started`, and see the source's status in Settings when it is unexpectedly `0`.

403.description: Signature missing or does not match.

404.description: No such source, or it has been revoked.

429.description: Secret-URL source over its limit of 60 requests a minute, while a workflow is listening on it.

detail.description: Error envelope. Every `/v1` error response wraps a stable `error` code and a human-readable `message` in `detail`.

detail.message: Exactly one of contact_id, to, chat_guid, or participant_phones is required

error.title: Error
error.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Use this for branching logic in your integration; the human-readable `message` is subject to change. See the Error Reference for the catalog.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
examples: Exactly one of contact_id, to, chat_guid, or participant_phones is required

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Contact's phone number as first seen. Usually E.164; a contact first created by an inbound SMS can carry the sender's bare national form (e.g. `4155551234`). Upserting any form of the same number returns this contact.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used for this contact's sending hours, or null if not set yet. When it is null and the number is a US or Canadian one, iBubbl infers the zone from the area code and saves it here when the contact's first message is processed; otherwise your account's timezone is used. Once set, an upsert never replaces it, so pass `timezone` on the first upsert, before you send, or change it with PATCH.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: The contact's tag names, sorted case-insensitively.

opted_out.title: Opted Out
opted_out.description: True if this contact has opted out (STOP reply or manual opt-out). When true, all send attempts to this contact return `422 contact_opted_out`.

opted_out_at.title: Opted Out At
opted_out_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the opt-out, or null.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the contact was created.

received.title: Received
received.description: Always `true` once the signature has been verified.

runs_started.title: Runs Started
runs_started.description: How many workflow runs this event started. `0` is a normal answer — it means no active workflow's trigger matched, or this event was a redelivery that de-duplicated onto an existing run.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: `outbound` = sent from your line (through the API, the dashboard or an automation); `inbound` = received from a contact. An inbound message has `status` `delivered`, or `read` once it has been read in the dashboard.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, with microseconds and a `Z`, of when iBubbl recorded the message. It never changes, so it is what `GET /v1/messages` sorts and filters by; pass it back as `created_after` / `created_before` unchanged.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. `pending` = accepted and on its way out; it may be waiting for the contact's working hours or the line's hourly limit for new contacts (see `held_until`). `queued` = parked by a capacity hold (`hourly_cap_hit` / `line_offline`), retried automatically. `sent` / `delivered` / `read` = delivery progression. `failed` = the send failed — see webhook `message.failed` for the reason; it can follow `sent` (or a `read` with no confirmed delivery) when iMessage reports the send failed after accepting it (`failed_reason` `imessage_undeliverable` / `imessage_error:<code>`), and such a message can still move to `delivered` / `read` if Apple later confirms it. `expired` = still queued after an hour, so dropped; it will not send. `cancelled` = stopped in the dashboard before it was sent; it will not send (webhook `message.cancelled`).

to.title: To
to.description: The contact's phone number (E.164) for 1:1 messages: the destination of an outbound message, and the sender of an inbound one. Null for group messages — the group is identified by `chat_guid` instead.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: ID of the contact this message was sent to. For groups, this is the 'primary' participant the message was addressed to (the first participant in `participant_phones` on a new group create); the conversation's full participant list is available via the conversation.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: ID of the conversation this message belongs to. Stable for the lifetime of the conversation; use it to fetch the thread or correlate webhook events.

conversation_kind.title: Conversation Kind
conversation_kind.description: `one_to_one` for sends to a single contact, `group` for iMessage groups (2+ participants in addition to your iBubbl line).

chat_guid.title: Chat Guid
chat_guid.description: Opaque identifier for the group chat (e.g. `any;+;<hex>`). Returned for `group` messages — use it to address later messages to the same group via the `chat_guid` request shape. Null for `one_to_one` messages, and for a brand-new group until the group has been created in iMessage (that happens when the first message goes out, which can wait for sending hours); poll `GET /v1/messages/{id}` to see it fill in. It changes when a participant is added to the group.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: How the message travelled: `imessage`, or `sms` (a text, including RCS). For an outbound message, how it actually went out (`sms` when the recipient couldn't be reached on iMessage); null until it has been sent. For an inbound message, how it arrived; null when that wasn't recorded.

sent_at.title: Sent At
sent_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Set when the message is accepted, then replaced by the actual send time once it goes out. Use `status` (`sent` / `delivered` / `read`), not `sent_at`, to tell whether it has actually gone out.

held_until.title: Held Until
held_until.description: While a `pending` message is being held, the expected time (ISO 8601 UTC) it will go out: the next opening of the contact's working hours; for `hourly_limit`, an estimate of when a slot frees. Recomputed within about 10 seconds. Null when the message is not held, when `held_reason` is `working_hours` but no sending day is enabled, and when it is `hourly_limit` with no estimate.

held_reason.title: Held Reason
held_reason.description: Why a `pending` message is being held right now: `working_hours` (outside the contact's working hours) or `hourly_limit` (the line has started its limit of new contacts for this hour; the message goes out by itself when a slot frees, at about `held_until`). Null when it is not held.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: The iMessage send effect requested for this message, or null. It shows on the recipient's device only when `channel` is `imessage`.

reply_to_message_id.title: Reply To Message Id
reply_to_message_id.description: The ID of the message this one quotes as an inline reply, or null. The quote shows on the recipient's device only when `channel` is `imessage`.

example.body: Hey Sam — quick check-in about your order.

data.title: Data
data.description: Up to `limit` messages, newest first: by `created_at`, then by `id` for messages recorded in the same microsecond.

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Whether more messages match after the last one in `data`. To get them, repeat the request with `starting_after` set to that message's `id`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Must look like an email address, or `422 invalid_email`.

state.title: State
state.description: Trimmed, a 2-letter code upper-cased; blank clears it.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: One of the supported IANA zones, or `422 invalid_timezone`. `null` returns the contact to automatic: iBubbl infers the zone from a US or Canadian area code again.

ContactUpdate.title: ContactUpdate
ContactUpdate.description: Only the fields you send change. Send a field as `null` to clear it. `phone` can't be changed, and tags have their own endpoints. Fields not listed here are rejected with `422 validation_error`.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format (e.g. `+14155551234`). The unique key for contacts — upserting an existing phone returns the same contact ID.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Contact's first name. Only applied if the existing record's `first_name` is null — rep-edited values are sticky and won't be overwritten by automation. To change it, use `PATCH /v1/contacts/{id}`.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Contact's last name. Same sticky-update semantics as `first_name`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address. Must look like one (`name@domain.tld`, no spaces), or the call returns `422 invalid_email`. Same sticky-update semantics as `first_name`.

city.title: City
city.description: City. Trimmed; blank is treated as not sent. Same sticky-update semantics as `first_name`.

state.title: State
state.description: State, province or region. Trimmed, and a 2-letter code is upper-cased (`ny` → `NY`). Same sticky-update semantics as `first_name`.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for working-hours scheduling. Must be one of the supported allowlist (US/Canada timezones, plus common international). Sends to this contact respect the timezone for outside-hours scheduling. Same sticky-update semantics as names.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tag names to add, at most 20. Only ever adds: tags the contact already has are kept, and none are removed. A name matches an existing tag trimmed and case-insensitively (`vip` reuses `VIP`); a new name creates the tag. Each name is 1–64 characters with no invisible characters, or the call returns `422 invalid_tag` before anything is saved. A newly added tag can start workflows with a "Tag added" trigger.

ContactUpsert.title: ContactUpsert
ContactUpsert.description: Fields not listed here are rejected with `422 validation_error`.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: 1:1 send by existing contact ID (a UUID). Mutually exclusive with `to`, `chat_guid`, and `participant_phones`.

to.title: To
to.description: 1:1 send by E.164 phone number (e.g. `+14155551234`). If the number doesn't match an existing contact, one is created automatically. Mutually exclusive with `contact_id`, `chat_guid`, and `participant_phones`.

chat_guid.title: Chat Guid
chat_guid.description: Send into an existing iMessage group identified by its opaque `chat_guid` (e.g. `any;+;<hex>`). Webhook events don't carry it: read it from the response to a send into the group, or from `GET /v1/messages/{id}` for any message in the group (an inbound `message_id` works too). The value changes when a participant is added to the group; an old value then returns `404 group_not_found`. Mutually exclusive with `contact_id`, `to`, and `participant_phones`.

participant_phones.title: Participant Phones
participant_phones.description: Create a brand-new iMessage group and send the first message in one call. List of 2 or more E.164 phone numbers (your iBubbl line is added automatically; do not include it). Mutually exclusive with `contact_id`, `to`, and `chat_guid`. Optionally pair with `group_name` to set the group's display name.

group_name.title: Group Name
group_name.description: Display name for a new iMessage group. Only valid alongside `participant_phones`. Optional — iMessage will fall back to the participants' names if omitted.

body.title: Body
body.description:
The message text. Plain text only; emoji + Unicode are supported. For a line break, include a newline (`
` in the JSON string); use `
`, not `
`. A retry with the same `idempotency_key` must send the identical body, line breaks included, or it returns `409 idempotency_conflict`.
examples: Hey Sam — quick check-in about your order.

reply_to_message_id.title: Reply To Message Id
reply_to_message_id.description: Send as an inline reply that quotes an earlier message (a UUID: the `id` of a message, or the `message_id` of a `message.inbound` event). The message must be in the conversation you are sending to: the same contact for a 1:1 send, the same group for a `chat_guid` send; otherwise `422 reply_target_not_found`. A message the contact unsent returns `422 reply_target_unsent`, and one they unsent part of `422 reply_target_partly_unsent`. iMessage only: when the message goes out as SMS (see `channel`) it is sent as plain text, without the quote. Not allowed with `participant_phones`.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: An iMessage send effect. Bubble effects: `slam`, `loud`, `gentle`, `invisible` (Invisible Ink). Screen effects: `echo`, `spotlight`, `balloons`, `confetti`, `love`, `lasers`, `fireworks`, `celebration`, `shooting_star`. iMessage only: when the message goes out as SMS (see `channel`) it is sent without the effect. Not allowed with `participant_phones`.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied unique key per logical send. Keys never expire: reusing a key with the same payload replays the original message, however long ago it was sent, and the same key with a different payload returns `409 idempotency_conflict`. The one exception is a message that ended `failed` or `expired`: its key is released and the retry is sent as a new message. The payload compared is the routing field exactly as sent (`to`, `contact_id`, `chat_guid`, or the sorted `participant_phones` plus `group_name`), `body`, and `effect` and `reply_to_message_id` when set, so a retry that switches from `to` to the same contact's `contact_id` is a 409. Generate a new UUIDv4 for every distinct message.

MessageCreate.title: MessageCreate
MessageCreate.description: Fields not listed here are ignored without an error: the request still succeeds and they are not stored.

example.body: Hey Sam — quick check-in about your order.

name.title: Name
name.description: Tag name, 1–64 characters with no invisible characters. Matches an existing tag trimmed and case-insensitively; a new name creates the tag.

url.title: Url
url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive webhook POST requests. HTTP is rejected (`422 invalid_url`).

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Filter to a specific subset of events. Omit, or pass `null` or `[]`, to receive ALL event types, including ones added later. Every entry must be a type from the [Webhook Events catalog](/webhooks/events); an unknown type returns `422 validation_error`.

status.title: Status
status.description: `revoked` if this call performed the revocation; `already_revoked` if the subscription was already revoked.

secret_prefix.title: Secret Prefix
secret_prefix.description: First 14 characters of the signing secret (`whsec_` + 8 hex). Useful for identifying which subscription's secret is in use without revealing the full value. The full secret is returned only once, at creation time.

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Event filter, or null if subscribed to all events.

last_delivered_at.title: Last Delivered At
last_delivered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent successful delivery to this subscription, or null if no event has been delivered yet.

revoked_at.title: Revoked At
revoked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the subscription was revoked, or null if active. Revoked subscriptions stop receiving events.

secret_prefix.title: Secret Prefix
secret_prefix.description: First 14 characters of the signing secret (`whsec_` + 8 hex). Useful for identifying which subscription's secret is in use without revealing the full value. The full secret is returned only once, at creation time.

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Event filter, or null if subscribed to all events.

last_delivered_at.title: Last Delivered At
last_delivered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent successful delivery to this subscription, or null if no event has been delivered yet.

revoked_at.title: Revoked At
revoked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the subscription was revoked, or null if active. Revoked subscriptions stop receiving events.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Full signing secret. **Save it now** — this is the only time it is returned. Use it to verify the `X-iBubbl-Signature` header on incoming webhook POSTs (HMAC-SHA256 over `{t}.{raw request body}`, keyed with this whole string). See [Signature verification](/guides/webhook-signatures).

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Reminder that the secret cannot be retrieved again. Present only on the create response.

example.warning: Save this secret now — it cannot be retrieved again.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer API key. Format: `Authorization: Bearer ib_pk_<64 hex>` (70 characters). Generate keys from Dashboard → Settings → API Access.
